sender.description: Real low-activity wallet with SOL, USDC and USDT transfers; no label matches (normal sample). Includes a token account the wallet has since closed, discovered from its own later transactions. The window lies inside the provider's ~14-day history retention.

recipient.description: Real Solana address listed on the OFAC SDN list (Digital Currency Address - SOL). History contains only token-account creation and issuer freeze instructions, so there are no value transfers; the risk signal is the exact label match. The window lies inside the provider's ~14-day history retention.

pattern.description: Real wallet that sends to many distinct recipients within minutes. KYT ruleset 1.0.0 detects RAPID_FAN_OUT (>=3 recipients within 300s). A pattern signal only: it does not establish wrongdoing (payout/distribution wallets show the same shape).
